name: read_files
description:
Read up to 20 authorized local files in one call using the same scope and privacy rules as read_file. Returns each path with text/line counts or an error. max_lines_per_file limits extracted text.

For images, set image_mode="native" without line parameters to return actual pixels through the existing visual route after raw-image disclosure approval; image_mode="text" forces extraction. Native-capable models see pixels directly; text models use the configured interpreter. GIF uses its first frame. Without image_mode, privacy settings govern native evidence.

PDF/DOCX/PPTX without explicit line limits also provide originals to supported native routes when privacy permits; Office native input is text-only and PDF can include page images. XLSX uses structured extraction. Explicit line limits never send whole files.

paths.description: List of file paths to read (absolute or relative to a source root). Maximum 20 paths per call.

max_lines_per_file.description: Maximum number of lines returned per file. Default 500.

image_mode.description: native: inspect image pixels after disclosure approval; omit line parameters. text: extraction without pixels. Omitted: follow privacy settings. Applies to PNG/JPEG/WebP/GIF (first frame).
